Go to the hospital, get more supplies, and bring them to the medical droid throughout the attack zone.|[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Harvin Franchels|Franchels]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:HwtaotTA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Help with the aftermath of the Terrorist Attack|Naboo}}</ref>}}
The '''Theed Medical Center''',<ref name="AED" /> best known as the '''Theed Hospital''',<ref name="SWG:HwtaotTA" /> was a [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]] located in the city of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], on the world [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="AED" />

==History==
During the [[terrorist attack in Theed]] that took place following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Harvin Franchels|Franchels]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] requisitioned medical supplies from the Theed Hospital to the [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]] deployed in the attack zone.<ref name="SWG:HwtaotTA" />
